text:
alyssa: Opening a tiny relnotes PR for the routing/migration updates. Need: 1) one-line whats-new, 2) short migration tip, 3) curl + python snippets, 4) known-issue note. Will push in ~15m and request quick review.

vikram: Please include the exact config key: adaptive_routing.enabled. Ops also wants the fallback order spelled out (hosted -> dedicated -> fallback-variant).

jess: I'll write the curl example and the short whats-new bullet for the changelog feed (<= 80 chars).

tom: QA: include repro steps for the T4 KV-warmup perf blip at seq=512 and a staging link. Also ask docs-ci to run linkcheck after redirects.

ci-bot: Created PR #5012 (staging preview): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-routing/preview-5012. Current linkcheck: 1 404 (/tutorials/legacy-routing).

alyssa: Added redirect from /tutorials/legacy-routing -> /docs/adaptive-routing/migrate and a compact migration tip: "If you use route-level caching, pre-warm KV or gradually ramp traffic."

jess: Draft whats-new (for feed): "Adaptive routing (beta): opt-in cost-aware routing with configurable fallbacks."

jess: Curl snippet (for changelog):
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rodeo-3","prompt":"Write a haiku","routing":{"adaptive_routing":{"enabled":true}}}'

alyssa: Python snippet (how-to):
from redwood import Client
with Client() as client:
    r = client.generate("Summarize this doc", model="rodeo-3", routing={"adaptive_routing": {"enabled": True}})
    print(r.text)

vikram: Known issue note: On some T4 nodes a transient ~5-12ms increase at seq=512 has been observed while KV cache warms. Repro: ssh to staging and run ./tools/bench --seq 512 --target routing-canary. Mitigation: pin variant or disable adaptive_routing for latency-sensitive routes.

tom: After you merge, I'll add the one-line feed entry and validate the known-issues anchor.

ci-bot: Linkcheck (preview-5012) now: 0 404s, 0 lint errors. Full: https://ci.redwood.ai/reports/5012/linkcheck

alyssa: Thanks all 680 merging in ~5m. Please watch release-index render; if the curl code block escapes weirdly ping me and I'll tweak.
